-- Usuários com empresaVinculada preenchido (legado puro — sem vínculos em userEmpresas)
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.empresaVinculada, u.tenantId,
       COUNT(ue.id) as total_vinculos_atuais
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN userEmpresas ue ON ue.userId = u.id
WHERE u.empresaVinculada IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email, u.empresaVinculada, u.tenantId
ORDER BY u.tenantId, u.name;

-- Resumo geral
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_usuarios,
  SUM(CASE WHEN empresaVinculada IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as com_legado,
  SUM(CASE WHEN empresaVinculada IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_legado
FROM users;
